title: Chapter 74
text:
The car was parked outside, and everyone moved the equipment into the secret base. The pre-battle meeting began.

"We have two missions. First, disguise ourselves as wanderers and infiltrate Crow Forest Town to gather intel. Second, find the Germinal Organization sentries nearby and interrogate them about the situation at Dark Crow Valley base."

Winna immediately said, "We will deal with the sentries. You guys go to Crow Forest Town."

Di Su Su frowned. There might be Germinal Organization spies hiding in Crow Forest Town, and there was a risk of being exposed. It was not easy to gain anything. It was easier to obtain intel from the sentries, and it was safer for them.

Hesla's people could not wait to hand over the dangerous and difficult mission to Division 13. This attitude made the people of Division 13 unhappy, but the mission had to be completed. No one objected.

Qi Bai Jia said, "To infiltrate Crow Forest Town, we have to disguise ourselves as wanderers first. Then, we have to find an opportunity to gather intel secretly. We must not alert the enemy."

After a discussion, they decided to leave some people in the secret base. Four people stayed behind: Lin Yao, Qi Bai Jia, Ma Qing Yang, and Han Xiao.

On the other hand, Hesla also left a few people in the secret base. Han Xiao only recognized Ye Fan among them.

It was afternoon, and Hesla's people decided to rest first. They would set off to look for the sentries at dawn. That was the time when the enemy was most relaxed. They were equipped with thermal imaging devices, and the darkness was advantageous to them. They also wanted Division 13 to scout for mines first.

After finalizing the plan, the agents from Division 13 who had decided to infiltrate formed a team with Di Su Su as the leader. All of them changed into rogues' outfits. They hunched their backs, looking as though they were being pressured by an invisible force. Their disguises were very convincing. They carried a huge backpack and walked towards the Crow Forest.

There were many computer screens in the secret base that were connected to the images and earphones of the agents. Han Xiao, Lin Yao, and Qi Bai Jia took turns to monitor the screens.

Not long after, Di Su Su and the rest arrived at Crow Forest Town. The screen showed the appearance of a small town with all kinds of buildings. Although the houses were small and shabby, they were densely populated. It was like a market. The town was not small, and it had everything. There were even hotels that were open to welcome guests.

"Let's find a place to stay first."

Di Su Su and the rest were interrogated by the locals. She answered fluently and pretended to be a group of migrating wanderers. Coincidentally, they were passing by and hoped to rest for a few days. After getting rid of the interrogation, they stayed in a hotel in the town.

After entering the room, everyone immediately displayed their professionalism and checked the room for surveillance cameras and bugs. After confirming that everything was safe, they began to discuss the next step of the plan.

"What should we do next?" Li Ya Lin curled her lips and looked at Di Su Su with disdain.

Di Su Su was not in the mood to tease Li Ya Lin. She frowned and said seriously, "Our identities are still suspicious. It's best for us to stay put for now."

Han Xiao suddenly said in the earpiece, "You'd better act tonight."

"Reason?" Di Su Su raised her eyebrows slightly.

"You are now a group of foreign wanderers. Play your role well and inquire about the local situation. If you deliberately hide, your actions will be abnormal, and it will easily expose your ulterior motives."

"That makes sense." Everyone looked at each other.

"… Let's do as Han Xiao says."

There were entertainment facilities in the town, such as a small casino, a shop selling psychotropic drugs, a restaurant, and facilities to relieve physical needs. At night, everyone would go out in twos and threes and pretend to be normal. They would ask for information and collect information, but they did not find anything substantial. Most of the residents here were normal wanderers, and they did not find any suspicious targets.

Qi Bai Jia's face was solemn. "The other party is too secretive. It will be difficult to find anything."

"Not necessarily." Han Xiao smiled. He knew that there was a special spy in Crow Forest Town. Players could choose to join the Germinal Organization after completing missions to gain favorability. As long as they caught this NPC, they would be able to get a lot of information.

Han Xiao knew the exact location of the Dark Crow Valley base, but he did not know the exact military strength. It was too small. After more than ten years, he only had a vague impression of such details. Furthermore, the time was different now, and Han Xiao was not sure if there were any changes. Therefore, it was necessary to gather information.

"Go to the south of the town. There is a casino. There should be a bald man inside. That person knows about the Dark Crow Valley base." The person Han Xiao was talking about was the Germinal Organization's spy in Crow Forest. Players who were born in Crow Forest could only join the Germinal Organization through him.

Everyone was stunned. Di Su Su frowned and asked, "Where did you get this information?"

"I naturally have my ways."

"What if the information is wrong?" Di Su Su did not give up.

"Listen to him," Qi Bai Jia interrupted. Before they left, his superior had told him to trust Han Xiao. It was obvious that the superiors valued Han Xiao.

Di Su Su could only suppress her doubts and listen to the order. She led the team to the small casino in the south and secretly asked around. Indeed, they found a bald man. He was the dealer of the casino.

"What should we do now? If we act rashly, we will alert the enemy. Who knows if there are accomplices around? "Di Su Su asked.

Han Xiao said helplessly, "Why are you asking me when you have already found him? Can't you show some professionalism?"

Di Su Su's chest tightened. She was so angry that she could not speak. However, she also realized that she had asked a stupid question. She snorted angrily and called for her teammates to secretly surround Han Xiao.

Han Xiao looked at the time and got up to take over Lin Yao's night shift. He did not need to monitor the specific operation. If there were any accidents, the secret service agents should just kill themselves.

At the same time, Winna left with the Hesla agents. Before she left, she did not forget to give Han Xiao a dirty look.

Han Xiao did not intend to rest in the stronghold. He walked out of the stronghold and returned to Big Black's cargo compartment.

The two reconnaissance missions were team missions. If there were no accidents, he should be able to complete them. Therefore, he should focus on his personal mission. If he wanted to assassinate the sentry in the jungle, he would need some small tools.

Han Xiao took out the parts and focused on the interface.

Do you want to proceed with knowledge fusion (Basic Wide-area Perception + Basic Bionics + Basic Mechanical Engineering)? This fusion will cost 15,000 EXP.

[Congratulations on developing [Small Arthropod Detector (Spider)]!]

…

Winna and her team were wearing night vision goggles and camouflage suits. They walked quietly in the jungle like hunters in the dark forest, looking for their prey.

They would only encounter the sentry when they were close to the Dark Crow Valley base. There was a master tracker in the team who could determine the road conditions from a day ago based on the traces in the jungle.

This tracking master was called Magenu, and he was a tall and sturdy Shanubi. His body was like a small mountain, and very few people would think that he was a meticulous person. At this time, he rubbed the dirt, put it to the tip of his nose, and sniffed it. He closed his eyes and thought for a while, then said, "Seven hours ago, a person, male, weighing about 180 pounds, heading southwest."

Winna did not doubt Magenu's judgment. She led her team carefully toward the direction. Suddenly, she stopped. The thermal imaging device showed that there was a lifeform squatting on a tree 300 meters away.

"Check the surroundings!"

Winna was very calm. She did not act rashly. She asked her teammates to check if there were any hidden sentry or surveillance devices nearby. After 20 minutes, she confirmed that everything was safe.

"Take him down!" Ye Fan ordered through the communication device.

Winna suddenly moved. A dark red glow flashed under her feet. She quickly and quietly approached the sentry within a hundred meters. With the help of the trees, she hid herself in the sentry's blind spot. She was like a master assassin. She flipped over a tree like a cat. Her palms were also glowing with a dark red glow. She was like an octopus clinging to the trunk of a tree. She kept leaping, suppressing the sound of the wind as she approached the sentry in the air.
